title: 第十八章 他就是秦弦！
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
萧姚马不停蹄地蹿出传送阵，踏上飞舟，下飞舟后又钻进传送阵，接着再上飞舟，中间换乘无数次，以最快的速度赶到合欢宗所在的云雨城。

    一路上，苍岚真就像他说的那样，认真扮演解压的毛茸茸角色。

    他静静地看着萧姚与狐朋狗友探讨其他男人，为另一个男人急得坐立难安，距离风评不良的合欢宗越来越近，却没有表现出半点醋意。

    萧姚对此十分满意，把悬着的心放回去了一半。

    她就说，小狼对她只是雏鸟情结……不对，是认主情结，怎么可能会真的对她这种人傻钱多的纨绔动心？

    嗐，自己吓自己。

    萧姚满意地撸了一把苍岚的尾巴，继续远程指挥程宛君撑局面。

    苍岚的余光洒向传讯符，眼神越来越冷。

    明月染尘？

    不就是一个孤芳自赏又沦落风尘的乐修，至于这么文绉绉地形容？

    苍岚垂眸，拨弄着小铃铛，在心里轻嗤一声：

    啧，这个女人的眼光，真差！

    ……

    这头，苍岚在心里小声蛐蛐。那边，萧姚对着传讯符激情开麦。

    【对面这么莽？连神机门和问天宗都不放在眼里？】

    【可不是嘛！那女修上来就自报家门，看起来像地头蛇，反正我没听说过。】

    【她居然没听过咱俩的名号？？？】

    【估计没有，不然也不会嚣张到找人围门了。我怎么就拉着师兄当打手呢，我好恨！丢死人了！！！】

    【君君不慌，我马上到，保准给你找回场子。】

    萧姚放下传讯符，心里大概有底了。

    对方不学好，但她不认识，说明也不是什么人物。

    萧姚跳下飞舟，带着恶狼，单枪匹马气势汹汹地杀向极乐馆。

    结果越往前走，眼神越清澈，最后看得鼻腔越来越热。

    合欢宗……不愧是双修圣地……男俊女靓，穿衣风格还特别慷慨，混合着让人耳红心跳的声音，当下就让嘴上开火车实际摇摇车的萧姚有点顶不住了。

    萧姚清了清嗓子，取出华丽的金属折扇扇风，试图将甜腻勾人的香味与正常空气剥离。

    苍岚也受到了冲击。

    他耳朵尾巴上的绒毛直接炸起，兽性逐渐被唤醒，柔弱无辜的伪装即将被撕碎，湿漉漉的狗狗眼慢慢变成凶狠的兽瞳，目光紧紧锁定前方的背影，獠牙利爪若隐若现……

    “啧，真难闻。小狼，把清心丹吃了，闭上眼，别被他们带坏了。”

    她家纯情小狼刚才的眼神，让她后背发凉。

    啧，合欢宗的迷香果然邪门，居然还能激发妖族的兽性？

    苍岚嘴里被塞进清凉的丹药，视线被手掌遮挡，熟悉的气息近在咫尺，混沌失控的思绪重新归拢。

    苍岚外放的气势终于被压回躯壳，露出獠牙的恶狼又变回了乖巧听话的狼崽。

    “姐姐……苍岚乖乖听话，不会乱看的。”

    苍岚闭上眼，睫毛轻轻颤动，小刷子般擦过萧姚的掌心。

    萧姚刷的收回手，扯着苍岚的手腕，用扇子开路，顶着越来越浓郁的香味一路疾行，终于到了极乐馆门口。

    “让本小姐看看，是哪个不长眼的，居然敢跟本小姐抢人？”
content_en:
Xiao Yao jumped out of the teleportation array non-stop, stepped on the flying boat, got off the flying boat and got into the teleportation array, then boarded the flying boat again, changing trains countless times in the middle, and rushed to Yunyu City where the Hehuan Sect was located as quickly as possible.

Along the way, Cang Lan really did what he said, seriously playing the role of a furry person who relieves stress.

He quietly watched Xiao Yao discussing other men with his friends, and he was so worried about the other man that he was getting closer and closer to the Hehuan Sect, which had a bad reputation, but he did not show any jealousy.

Xiao Yao was very satisfied with this and put his heart back halfway.

She said that Xiaolang only had a fledgling complex towards her... No, it was a master complex. How could he really be attracted to a stupid and wealthy playboy like her?

Hey, you're scaring yourself.

Xiao Yao stroked Cang Lan's tail with satisfaction and continued to remotely command Cheng Wanjun to support the situation.

Cang Lan's peripheral vision cast towards the communication talisman, her eyes getting colder and colder.

The bright moon is stained with dust?

Isn't he just a solitary and self-admired music cultivator who has fallen into the dust of the world? How can he be described in such a formal way?

Cang Lan lowered her eyes, played with the little bell, and sneered in her heart:

Gee, this woman’s taste is really bad!

…

On this side, Cang Lan whispered in her heart.Over there, Xiao Yao opened the microphone passionately to the messenger.

[Is the other side so reckless?Do you even ignore Shenji Sect and Wentian Sect?】

【you do not say!The female cultivator introduced herself to her family when she came up. She looked like a local snake, but I had never heard of her.】

[She has never heard of our names???】

[Probably not, otherwise he wouldn’t be so arrogant as to find someone to surround the door.Why did I drag my senior brother to be a thug? I hate it so much!What a shame!!!】

[Don't panic, sir, I'll be there soon, and I'll make sure to find your place.】

Xiao Yao put down the communication talisman, feeling confident.

The other party didn't learn well, but she didn't know him, which meant he wasn't a good person.

Xiao Yao jumped off the flying boat, took the evil wolf with him, and single-handedly attacked the Paradise Pavilion with great momentum.

As a result, the further I walked, the clearer my eyes became, and finally my nasal cavity became hotter and hotter.

Hehuan Sect...is indeed a holy land for dual cultivation...with handsome men and beautiful women, and a very generous dressing style. Mixed with the sound that makes people's ears red and heartbeat, Xiao Yao, who talks about driving a train but actually rocks a car, is a little overwhelmed.

Xiao Yao cleared his throat and took out a gorgeous metal folding fan to fan himself, trying to separate the sweet and tantalizing fragrance from the normal air.

Cang Lan was also shocked.

The fluff on the tail of his ears exploded, and his animal nature was gradually awakened. His weak and innocent disguise was about to be torn to pieces. The wet dog eyes slowly turned into fierce beast eyes. His eyes were locked on the back in front of him, and his fangs and claws were looming...

"Tsk, it smells really bad. Little Wolf, take the Qingxin Pill and close your eyes. Don't let them lead you astray."

The look in her innocent little wolf's eyes just now sent chills down her back.

Tsk, the incense of the Hehuan Sect is really evil, can it actually stimulate the beastly nature of the demon clan?

A cool elixir was stuffed into Cang Lan's mouth, her sight was blocked by her palms, the familiar breath was so close, and her chaotic and out-of-control thoughts came together again.

Cang Lan's outward aura was finally suppressed back into her body, and the evil wolf with its fangs turned back into a well-behaved and obedient wolf cub.

"Sister... Cang Lan is obedient and won't look around."

Cang Lan closed her eyes, her eyelashes trembling slightly, brushing against Xiao Yao's palm like a small brush.

Xiao Yao quickly retracted his hand, took Cang Lan's wrist, used a fan to clear the way, and rushed all the way against the increasingly strong fragrance, and finally arrived at the entrance of the Paradise Pavilion.

"Let me see, who is this blind person who dares to steal someone from me?"
